retrieval_policy.future_retrieval_authority: later explicitly authorized ingestion or retrieval job
future_requirements: Treat every URL as an unverified pointer until a recorded retrieval succeeds.
Respect access controls and asset-level licenses; do not bypass authentication, paywalls, robots restrictions, or other controls.
Record resolved URL, provenance, license, checksum, retrieval time, and validation label for retained artifacts.
Keep source repositories read-only and copy permitted working inputs only into the per-attempt workspace.
Exclude secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, examiner materials, and other learners' files from learner-visible locations.
Classify resource granularity before adding any retrieved record to the unit graph.
retrieval_policy.on_failure: Record the attempt and reason as blocked; do not fabricate, silently substitute, or promote the material to available.
